entries.reasoning: The proposed contract requires AtliQ to develop and deploy a revenue management and guest analytics platform for Gulf Crown Hotels & Resorts Co., which is a hospitality business operating in Saudi Arabia (GCC). This collides with the Al Noor restriction prohibiting AtliQ and its Affiliates from providing data analytics, artificial intelligence, or revenue management services to any GCC hospitality business. This restriction is active until September 2029. Additionally, signing the warranty in Clause 9.1(d) would be untrue because of the Al Noor restriction.

incomingClauses.quote: The Service Provider shall design, develop, test, deploy and support a revenue management and guest analytics platform for the Company's nine (9) Properties located in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, as listed in Schedule 2.

Revenue Management Module — demand forecasting at room-type and night level, dynamic rate recommendations, competitor rate ingestion, pickup and pace analysis, and a length-of-stay and overbooking optimisation engine;

Guest Analytics Module — a unified guest profile consolidating data from the Company's property management system, central reservation system, loyalty programme and point-of-sale systems; guest segmentation; lifetime value scoring; and propensity models for upsell and repeat stay;
it is not bound by any agreement or restriction which would prevent or restrict it from performing the Services for the Company.

entries.suggestedChange: Seek a written waiver or consent from Al Noor Hospitality Group, or defer the engagement until after the restriction period ends in September 2029. The business team and legal counsel should decide on the appropriate strategy.
entries.waiverWhy: The Al Noor waiver is strictly limited to the Seaside SOW for Seaside Hotels LLC in Oman and explicitly does not extend to other GCC hospitality businesses.
entries.impact: Collides with the Al Noor promise, live until September 2029.
